Usage: protonvpn connect [OPTIONS] [SERVER_NAME]

  Connect to Proton VPN server.

  Arguments:

  SERVER_NAME Connect to specific server by ID (e.g., IT#23)

Options:
  --country TEXT     Connect to fastest server in specified country
                     Country code (US, GB, DE) or full name ("United States")
  --city TEXT        Connect to fastest server in specified city
                     City name (use quotes for multi-word: "New York")
  --p2p              Connect to fastest P2P-optimized server
  -sc, --securecore  Connect to fastest Secure Core server
  --tor              Connect to fastest Tor server
  --random           Connect to random available server
  -h, --help         Show this message and exit.

  Examples:
    # Quick connection
    protonvpn connect                     # Fastest server globally
  
    # Location selection
    protonvpn connect --country US        # Fastest in United States
    protonvpn connect --city "New York"   # Fastest in New York
    protonvpn connect IT#23               # Specific server
  
    # Feature-based selection
    protonvpn connect --p2p               # Fastest P2P server
    protonvpn connect --country IT --p2p  # Fastest P2P in Italy
  
    # Extra secure connections
    protonvpn connect --securecore        # Secure Core routing
    protonvpn connect --tor               # Tor over VPN
